queries_run: Fabrinet market share gaining OR losing 2026 competitor InnoLight Celestica
Fabrinet new entrant displace threat optical manufacturing NVIDIA Celestica 2026

findings.claim: 10-K 列出光學製造服務對手含 Benchmark、Celestica、InnoLight、Jabil、Sanmina、Venture、Eoptolink 及客戶自製能力；公司稱進入門檻高（銷售週期長、須證明精密光電製造能力、保護客戶 IP）
findings.excerpt: Competitors in the market for optical manufacturing services include Benchmark Electronics, Inc., Celestica Inc., InnoLight Technology (Suzhou) Ltd., Jabil Inc., Sanmina Corporation, Venture Corporation Limited and Eoptolink Technology Inc., Ltd., as well as the internal manufacturing capabilities of our customers.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：其他代工、ODM 或封測公司可能進入目標市場，產業整併可能產生更大對手；新競爭可能導致降價、毛利下降或失去份額
findings.excerpt: Other existing contract manufacturing companies, original design manufacturers or outsourced semiconductor assembly and test companies could also enter our target markets.

competitive_share_entrants.note: 搜尋未找到第三方明確份額消長數據；搜尋摘要提及客戶自製與 NVIDIA 投資 Lumentum/Coherent 屬二手轉述，未取得可逐字原文，不列入。
